brief.headline: Move to 30-day credit to unlock ₹8.73 L working capital, and close the ₹12.95 L annual price gap against our best supplier at ₹66.48/KG

priceAsk.summary: Reduce Dextrose price from ₹70.80/KG to ₹66.48/KG to match our lowest supplier
priceAsk.basis: We already pay Sayaji Industries Limited ₹66.48/KG for the same material — a 6.5% gap. Closing it saves ₹12.95 L annually. The India export unit value for Dextrose is 42.95 ₹/kg, well below both prices, so ₹66.48/KG is a fair domestic benchmark.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Shift from 100% advance to standard 30-day credit terms

brief.financialLeverage: Sukhjit reported revenue of ₹1458.95 Cr with a thin 2.3% net margin and 6.4% EBITDA margin, so deep price cuts risk their viability. Debt-to-equity is moderate at 0.61x, but their health score is D (39/100). Our ₹1.06 Cr spend is only 0.07% of their revenue — we are a rounding error, which limits standalone leverage. However, their slim margins mean they badly need to avoid tying up cash in advance payments. Push hardest on payment terms; on price, frame it as alignment with market reality rather than a margin squeeze.

evidence.point: We pay 6.5% more than our best supplier for Dextrose
Our best price for Dextrose is ₹66.48/KG from Sayaji Industries Limited
Closing the price gap saves us ₹12.95 L per year
We currently pay 100% in advance, the worst payment terms in our vendor base
Moving to 30-day credit unlocks ₹8.73 L in working capital
India export unit value for Dextrose is 42.95 ₹/kg, far below what we pay

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch & polyol maker; established dextrose/sorbitol supplier — a drop-in alternate to Gujarat Ambuja/Sayaji.

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist (starch, dextrose) — growing capacity.

alternates.name: Roquette India Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Indian arm of global starch major Roquette — pharma-grade dextrose/excipients; premium, very reliable.

risks: At ₹1.06 Cr and 0.07% of their ₹1458.95 Cr revenue, we have negligible leverage — they can afford to lose us. Bundle commitments or threaten credible alternate sourcing.
Their 2.3% net margin is razor-thin; aggressive price demands could push them to exit or cut corners. Focus the fight on payment terms, where the cost to them is lower.
100% advance payment gives them zero incentive to negotiate — we've already handed over all leverage. Make payment-term shift non-negotiable to rebalance the relationship.
Health score of D (39/100) signals potential instability; if we push too hard and they falter, supply continuity is at risk. Qualify alternates now.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the relationship, but paying ₹70.80/KG when we source identical Dextrose at ₹66.48/KG elsewhere — and funding you 100% in advance — isn't sustainable; let's align on both price and standard 30-day terms today.
